description_expanded: Cliffview is a rare Gulf-front treasure on Blue Mountain Beach , offering five bedrooms, five baths, and accommodations for up to 14 guests in a setting that feels both private and deeply connected to the water. The spectacular views are truly unrivaled, stretching across the turquoise blue Gulf and filling the home with light from sunrise to those unforgettable, almost spiritual sunsets. Families return year after year for the sense of space, comfort, and tradition this home provides—where the first stop after arrival is always the deck, simply to take it all in. Here, the beauty of the shoreline feels close, immediate, and timeless. Inside, the floor plan is exceptionally spacious, designed for gathering without ever feeling crowded. The living room, dining area, and kitchen all focus on the view, with large windows and sliding glass doors that frame the sweeping Gulf backdrop. Vintage Mid-Century Modern touches and authentic Old Florida charm give the home warmth and character that’s increasingly hard to find along today’s coastline. The kitchen is well equipped for family meals, with an avocado-toned counter bar connecting formal and casual dining spaces with ease. Just beyond, the expansive covered screened porch and grandfathered-in sundeck sit remarkably close to the shoreline, creating an extraordinary vantage point over the sand and sea. Halfway down the private boardwalk, a special seating area invites you to pause with coffee at sunrise or gather at dusk as the sky turns brilliant shades of gold and rose. Three of the five bedrooms enjoy Gulf views, including the Primary Suite, which opens directly to an observation sun deck overlooking the water. Each bedroom features its own private bath, making the layout especially comfortable for multi-generational families. There is plenty of room for children to spread out, cousins to share stories late into the evening, and adults to unwind after a sun-soaked day on the beach. The setting feels quiet and naturally secluded, offering your own stretch of sand with space to truly relax. Tucked toward the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac on Blue Mountain Beach Road , just moments from Scenic 30A, Cliffview balances privacy with convenience. Nearby coastal villages offer beloved restaurants, local shops, and seasonal events only a short drive away. Yet many guests find everything they need right here—on the deck, watching the spectacular sunset melt into the Gulf, listening to the gentle rhythm of the waves, and creating the kind of beach memories that bring families back summer after summer. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, King Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bedroom with Two Full Beds and Walk-In Shower, Bedroom with Two Queen Beds and Tub/Shower Combo,  Bedroom with Two Twin Beds and Tub/Shower Combo, Laundry.
